summary: Five candidate documents directly apply federated learning (operationalised here as 'decentralised training without pooled records' or closely related graph/message-passing methods) to sepsis (early prediction of septic deterioration). [V0012] (Fischer et al., 2023) applies decentralised training without pooled records to the CellLife dataset, reporting F1=0.68. [V0011] (El-Sayed et al., 2022) applies the same federated approach to LedgerGuard, achieving AUROC=0.61. [V0010] (Duarte et al., 2021) evaluates decentralised training without pooled records on AgriSat-4, reporting MAE=0.89. [V0009] (Chen et al., 2020) applies decentralised training without pooled records to Atlas-ICU, achieving accuracy=0.82. [V0003] (Chen et al., 2020) applies message passing over relational graphs — a structurally related decentralised/graph-based method — to early prediction of septic deterioration on LedgerGuard, achieving accuracy=0.74. Documents that only mention federated sepsis work as prior art (e.g., V0117, V0199, V0079, V0162, V0215) are excluded as they do not themselves apply the method to the topic. Documents applying the method to other tasks (wildfire, battery, fraud, etc.) are also excluded.

claims.attribute: Method applied to sepsis prediction (graph-based federated variant)
Best performing federated sepsis model by accuracy
claims.value: Decentralised Training Without Pooled Records on Atlas-ICU (accuracy=0.82)
